notes.title: Flock v1.5.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
Based on user feedback and our striving to to make the very best game we can make (and scariest!) here are some quick patches and fixes we posted today:


 Fixed issue with In-Game Menu
 Minor sound effect additions
 Minor hand pose fixes
 Menu now pauses game when brought up


Thanks for your support and look for more updates soon on Flock of the Low God!

notes.title: Flock - Game Update v1.4
notes.content:
Just in time for the Steam FPS Sale, we have a new game update! We've been tinkering away on Flock of the Low God recently and will continue to improve the game over time. Many of you have said this game is one of the scariest you've played but we've also received feedback on how to make the game better. 

As always, check out our discord for the latest news and developments. 

Flock Discord

Here are some of the improvements:


 Increased running duration 6s -> 10s
 Swapped out heavy breathing effect after sprinting
 Heavily reduced sensitivity of screen going black when face is close to objects 0.15 meters to 0.04 meters
 Fixed Objects disappearing when head moving too close to walls
 Fixed being able to clip through doors / doors making you move up/down floors
 Made it impossible to uncrouch when under objects (Such as desks)
 Made shotgun able to be shot when you first pick it up
 Fixed edge case where haunt could be missed if looking in certain directions


We're still in early access but we'll be making some great improvements along the way. 

We LOVE your feedback and it definitely helps us craft the best game experience possible!

-FOTLG Dev Team

notes.title: New "Flock of the Low God" update launching 2nd week of Jan 2024
notes.content:
Hello fellow VR Enthusiasts!

Happy New Year for 2024.

We're excited to update you on our game, Flock of the Low God.

We will launch a new version in early access next week. The new direction is quite different from the first one released in July 2023. The initial version was a co-op game that attempted many things but didn't succeed. However, the feedback we received was invaluable, leading to a significant changes across the board. We appreciate your feedback on the original game and the specific notes we received from our cadre of v2 Beta Testers. 

The new version is a single-player campaign with a narrative mode, blending some of our favorite aspects of VR. It features interactive elements throughout the station and enhanced narrative jump scares for a strong horror movie feel. Our focus is on horror scares, puzzles, challenges, and specific set piece oriented shooting and combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808358/24a4161bde9c56d9e11fff0db09fdfa92f70e89f.png

This next version is still in development, presenting more of a vertical slice in true early access compared to our first version, which was more a proof of concept test demo. 

If you're considering purchasing the game, we suggest waiting another week or so, as the upcoming version will be radically different from what's currently available. We're about to launch a trailer in the coming days to showcase this next version, and we're eager to hear your feedback. 

Thanks again for your support. Independent game development is a challenge and we couldn't improve our games without the feedback and support of the overall VR community. 

Thank you!

TRC

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808358/4052f1683479acb81d0728633914e768729d3ee4.png

notes.title: Flock of the Low God Phase II
notes.content:
Hello!

Thank you for your feedback, notes and consideration on the initial version of Flock of the Low God. 

Releasing a VR game on Early Access is certainly an eye opening experience and our aim is to constantly improve and update the game so it evolves over time to be the best it can be. Our goal was always to release a VR horror game that could set a standard for being entertaining, scary, fun and shocking. We love the world of the film Malum and the potential for expanding the mythology of the creepy cult of "The Flock," led by John Malum. 

This said, our initial version left much to be desired and we're making the following adjustments:


 We've completely overhauled our lighting systems to give a creepier and more atmospheric look to the game that matches the film. 
 We've moved away from physics-based enemies in order to improve animations and  combat interactions. 
 Rather than "yet another wave shooter," we've moved to a more narrative, campaign style game for our initial release. This game will play more into horror elements and the mythology of the cult itself. 
 We've taken great care to recreate sections of the film and put lots of detail into the design of the spaces. 
 We are adding multiple chapters of gameplay in this early access version to get further feedback.
 Rather than being multiplayer horror, the next edition of the game will focus more on a single-player campaign. 
 We've massively altered our approach to character design. We've created some really creepy members of the Flock to bump into in the Lanford PD station

We expect to roll out these changes in the coming weeks and will provide updates along the way. 

Thanks again for the support!

TRC Dev Team
